text: Charts of the whole Caeloran coast, and past it.
Half a shelf is given to places this game will never take you:
the far islands, the drowned shelf, a strait named for a woman.
A folio marked AVERRA - GENERAL. It is enormous.
Caelora is one corner of one sheet of it, and not the biggest corner.
A working chart of the harbour, pinned flat with lead weights.
The soundings along the east mole have been struck out and
redone in a fresh hand, twice, in the last two months.
